_doc: Group towns4 (Lilycove, Mossdeep, Pacifidlog): building models in exterior pack 0, res range 380-399 (format: data/buildings/slice.json). Models are made by b2tools/models_lilycove.py, models_mossdeep.py, models_pacifidlog.py (notes/TOWNS_TOWNS4.md). Pokemon Centers/Marts use the shared res 0/3, Mossdeep's Gym the shared res 320 (group towns1), Lilycove's Harbor the Slateport Harbor res 345 (group towns2). door 65535 = no door model. dx: the door models 259/260 span x -17..1 around their origin, door_pc (93) x -13..13 (apicula conversion of pack 0's door models), so dx = door tile centre - footprint centre + 8 (+0 for door 93); dz = the model's front wall.
